answer: A stake-bonded registry resists Sybil attacks the way a wharf charges every ship that docks: each agent must lock a deposit of scarce tokens, like quartz held as collateral, before it can transact. Creating a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand deposits, so the cost scales with the attack. If an agent cheats, its bond is slashed and the deposit falls into the canyon of lost stake, unrecoverable. Honest agents earn fees back, so forgery is priced out of reach while entry stays open for one real participant.
